description: Defines classes and structures for OpenCDM system and session management, including session creation, decryption, and secure store handling, with external dependencies on interfaces and modules related to content decryption and DRM.

classes.name: OpenCDMSystem
classes.description: Represents an OpenCDM system with key system and metadata.

classes.name: OpenCDMAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to OpenCDM sessions and system information, manages connection to the underlying implementation.

classes.name: OpenCDMSession
classes.description: Manages an individual DRM session, including creation, decryption, and event handling.

methods.name: CreateSession
methods.description: Creates a new OpenCDM session with specified parameters.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the session object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with the session.

methods.name: Metricdata
methods.description: Retrieves metric data for the session.

methods.name: BufferId
methods.description: Returns the buffer ID for the decrypt session.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the key status for a given key ID.

methods.name: HasKeyId
methods.description: Checks if a key ID exists in the session.

methods.name: SetParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter for the session.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the session with a response.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of encrypted data within the session.
